title: AXP publisher key directory
description: Served at https://<publisher>/.well-known/agent-extension-keys.json (SPEC section 8.5): the keys a publisher currently signs with. Hosts consult it when a manifest's signing key differs from the pinned one (rotation must move to a listed key; a listed new key with the pinned key delisted is a lost-key recovery that needs the user's explicit consent) and may consult it on first use (strict mode). Unknown fields are ignored.

publisher.description: The publisher DNS name; when present it MUST equal the domain the document is served from.

extensions.description: Restrict this key to these extension names; absent = every extension of the publisher.

revoked.description: A revoked key is listed so hosts can tell 'replaced' from 'never ours'; it never vouches for anything.
